version.changelog: Security fix: replaced npx -y tsx with native node .mjs scripts. Declared CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY credential in manifest.

llm.summary: This transcription skill does what it claims, but it can upload recordings and the API key to an undocumented, environment-controlled API destination.

dimensions.detail: Using CRAZYROUTER_API_KEY and uploading user-provided media is proportionate for cloud transcription, but accepting an arbitrary CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL without validation is broader than the documented Crazyrouter-only purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a SKILL.md and one local Node.js script; no installer, dependency installation, service registration, or remote code retrieval was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions disclose Crazyrouter API use, but they do not document that CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL can change the upload destination, and there is no runtime confirmation before sending potentially sensitive audio or video content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, shell profile changes, memory writes, or tool hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is speech-to-text via the Crazyrouter API, and the script reads a user-selected media file, sends it to an audio transcription or translation endpoint, and optionally writes the returned text to a user-selected output file.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Only use this skill with recordings you are willing to send to Crazyrouter or to whatever endpoint CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL names in the runtime environment. Prefer removing or tightly controlling CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL, and use a limited/rotatable API key if available.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Uploading the selected audio or video file to a third-party transcription API is expected for this skill, and SKILL.md names Crazyrouter API use; the concern is downgraded to a disclosure and consent issue rather than purpose mismatch.
[T09] unexpected: The artifact supports this concern: scripts/main.mjs uses CRAZYROUTER_BASE_URL directly as the API base and sends both the media file and Authorization bearer key there, while SKILL.md does not document or constrain that override.
